release_notes: Stick-figure cameo trigger state now persists across app restarts and computer shutdown. Previously the qualifying-send count, the random 4–8 target, and the last-qualifying timestamp were in-memory only, which meant closing and reopening the app reset both the count and the 10-minute spacing window. That made the anti-spam rule defeatable by quitting after each Ready. AnimationTrigger now writes count/target/last_qualifying_epoch into the shared config file (chairside_ready_alert_config.json) under a new 'anim_trigger_state' top-level key, using the same atomic temp+rename helpers that the animation_preferences and animation_character keys already use. The spacing timestamp is now wall-clock (time.time()) instead of process-monotonic, so the 10-minute floor still applies after a quit/relaunch. Loaded values are validated on read — out-of-range target or count is silently replaced with a fresh default so a stale config from a future MIN/MAX change can't wedge the trigger. Writes are wrapped so a full disk never surfaces an error on the Ready button. Constructor gains a load_from_storage flag, default False so unit tests stay deterministic; the main app passes load_from_storage=True.
